correctness.rationale: At every n>=3 with labelled W_n, rim with h=0 has x_i(t+1)=x_(i-1)x_(i+1) and with h=1 OR of the neighbors. The symmetric strict-sign energy implies eventual period <=2. Fixed hub supports only two complemented fixed states or, for even n, two alternating-rim two-cycle orbits. For flipping hub, unique h=0 representative must obey 2A>n, 2B<n and no isolated ones in cyclic step-two order. One odd ring or two even parity rings and the three-state transfer trace give exactly the stated N_n; compositions of runs of >=2 ones give coefficient m/r*binom(a-r-1,r-1)binom(m-a-1,r-1). Block concatenations 110/1110 and rho^4=rho+1 prove the exponential lower liminf (not an exact growth rate). Independent direct synchronous-update enumeration gives (fixed,primitive-orbits): n=3..12: (2,3),(2,2),(2,5),(2,11),(2,21),(2,34),(2,66),(2,77),(2,220),(2,227).
